subject.title: amazon-bedrock provider: Haiku 4.5 inference profile ARN not supported; params.modelId override ignored

question: Should the Amazon Bedrock plugin treat per-model `params.modelId` as the AWS `ConverseStreamCommand.modelId`, or require the selected OpenClaw model ref itself to carry the Bedrock profile ID/ARN?
rationale: Both shapes can plausibly fix the reporter's setup, but they create different user-visible model identity, status, docs, and compatibility semantics that automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Approve Bedrock-only `params.modelId` override
options.body: Document `params.modelId` as a Bedrock request-identity override and add tests proving status/model selection remains understandable while AWS receives the override.

options.title: Require canonical Bedrock profile refs
options.body: Support only explicit Bedrock model/profile IDs or ARNs as the selected model ref, and add discovery/alias handling for Haiku 4.5 instead of a hidden params override.

options.title: Defer until live registry issue is resolved
options.body: Pause this fix until #88707 no longer masks Bedrock live proof, accepting that Haiku 4.5 Bedrock users remain blocked meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Approve Bedrock-only `params.modelId` override
recommendation.body: Document `params.modelId` as a Bedrock request-identity override and add tests proving status/model selection remains understandable while AWS receives the override.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider runtime, config semantics, and public docs policy, which matches this person's recent provider/runtime boundary history.
